text:
Maya: dropping an updated Figma for the model catalog list + compare view. Main things: filters persistency, compare table density, perf badges, and a simpler version pin UX. quick review? https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/model-catalog-v2
Diego: skimmed it. love the direction. two big things: filters should remember state per workspace, and badges need shorter surface text with expanded tooltip details.
Ravi: agree on persistency. also we should avoid auto-applying complex filters on quick search. maybe keep explicit 'Apply filters' button.
Maya: yep — plan: persistent per-user toggle + explicit "Apply" for multi-select filters. quick keyword search remains instant.
Claire: compare table is too tight right now. proposal: +6px vertical padding, subtle row striping, and better column headers that stay visible when sticky.
Diego: subtle striping is fine but ensure it stays low contrast. also headers need sort icons with 12px click targets.
A11yBot: accessibility flags: badge background #f7e5b0 on white fails contrast. Also keyboard focus for rows missing. Recommend focus ring and role="row" + tabindex.
Zach: will add focus ring and `tabindex=0` on rows. suggestion for CSS: `.catalog-row:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); background: rgba(3,102,214,0.06); }` and add `aria-selected` when included in compare.
Maya: sample microcopy: badge text short: 'low-latency', tooltip: 'p99 latency: 48ms (gpu: a100)'. keep badge visually compact.
Diego: copy nit: use kebab-case single-word badges for compactness. Tooltips should show units and percentile (p50/p99).
Ravi: pin UX — we need clearer signal that pinning changes routing. My thought: icon pin toggles a mini-sheet with options: project-only | org-wide, and a confirmation if org-wide.
Claire: backend note: org-wide pins require a small API change (new scope field). if we add UI for it, we need to version the endpoint.
Maya: UI idea: move the pin into header as a subtle icon state. clicking opens sheet with two radios, short explanation and a link to docs. keep it small, not a full modal.
Diego: microcopy for sheet: header 'Pin model version' and helper: 'Incoming requests will route to the pinned version. This does not change active rollouts unless you opt in.' show red accent for org-wide pin.
A11yBot: additional a11y: ensure pin control is keyboard operable, sheet has `role=dialog` + `aria-modal=true`, trap focus, and announce pinning action via `aria-live`.
Zach: will prototype keyboard behavior + focus trap + add aria-live message 'Model v2.1 pinned for project'. also update badge palette to meet 4.5:1.
Maya: filters UX: show counts on each filter option (e.g., 'quantized (2)') and a filter indicator in top bar that shows active filter count. keyboard should allow opening filter chips with Enter.
Diego: +1 to topbar pill showing number. also add a 'Clear filters' affordance next to it.
Ravi: action items: Zach tackle a11y + CSS, Diego finalize short badge strings and tooltips, Claire scope API change for org pins, Maya update Figma and copy. I'll book a 15-min sync tomorrow to sign off.
Maya: thanks everyone! tagging follow-ups: @Zach PR, @Claire api-scope, @Diego badge-copy :thumbsup:
